metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 1988 · Young Guns
metas.description: A group of young gunmen, led by Billy the Kid, become deputies to avenge the murder of the rancher who became their benefactor. But when Billy takes their authority too far, they become the hunted.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1990 · Young Guns II
metas.description: Billy the Kid and his band of outlaws are pursued across New Mexico territory by Sheriff Pat Garrett, who the young gunslingers must face-off with if they are to reach the safety of the border.
